title: Agent payouts, commission and instant payout
keywords: agent payout commission 80% 20% instant payout wallet $200 reserve blackout giro
body: Agents keep 80% of the delivery fee; uParcel keeps 20%.
Payout by GIRO: jobs on days 1–15 paid on days 22–24; days 16–31 paid on days 7–9 of the next month.

Instant payout: wallet must stay above $200; $2–$1,000 per day; $1 fee per request; one request a day; approved next working day; not during claims, frozen accounts or blackout dates (13th–16th and 29th–1st).
New agents are limited to 7 jobs until 20+ deliveries and a 4+ rating.
Late delivery: uParcel may deduct up to 50% of the fee; repeated delays lead to deactivation.
